decisions.reason: The source changes only the hero visual asset; it does not change the hero headline or supporting copy.
The source refers specifically to the graphic displaying the sales page on a mobile phone, not the separate image at the bottom of the website.
Replacing one hero image does not alter the approved clean, minimal SaaS design style, palette source, or design reference.
The hero asset replacement does not change the landing page content mix, specification source, screenshot-selection rule, or overall layout.
The reference to a mobile phone describes the hero graphic and does not affect the form-only contact-channel requirement.
The mobile-phone reference is part of the selected hero image and does not change any fields collected by the early-access form.
The source changes a hero visual asset and does not revise the founding-dealer headline or campaign copy.
The hero image replacement does not change the early-access button trigger, destination, or destination form.
The source does not affect form-submission triggers or email recipients.
Replacing the hero image with another static graphic does not change the requirement that animations remain disabled.
The selected hero graphic does not change the dealer-login button placement.
